hero.title: Settle claims *before* they're filed.
hero.line: Newron's claims models inspect documents, parse policy language and predict denial risk the moment a claim is initiated — so adjusters spend their time on edge cases, not paperwork.

sections.title: Three checkpoints, fully automated.
sections.line: From first notice of loss to a TPA-ready packet, Newron handles the mechanical work and escalates only what needs a human.

cards.d: Policy retrieval and document understanding flag missing artefacts and ineligible claims at intake — before they enter the queue.
Forms, supporting documents and metadata assembled into TPA-ready packets in under 90 seconds.
Predicts likely denial reasons against historical adjudication data and suggests remediation pre-emptively.

sections.title: Fewer denials, *faster* settlements.
sections.line: Measured across health and motor lines at insurers and TPAs running Newron in production. The settlement figure is the TPA turnaround we observe, not a Newron commitment.

sections.title: Built for messy, *real-world* claims.
sections.line: Newron reads discharge summaries, prescriptions, invoices, FIRs and policy schedules — printed or handwritten.

steps.label: INTAKE
steps.d: Discharge summaries, bills, prescriptions and policy schedules parsed and cross-checked.

steps.label: ELIGIBILITY
steps.d: Sub-limits, waiting periods and exclusions evaluated against the specific policy schedule.

steps.label: FILING
steps.d: A complete, TPA-ready packet with every required artefact attached and indexed.

steps.label: ADJUDICATION
steps.d: Likely denial reasons surfaced with the historical evidence behind them.

steps.label: SETTLEMENT
steps.d: Gaps closed before submission, shortening the back-and-forth with the TPA.

faq.q: Which lines of business are supported?
faq.a: Health and motor are in production today. No other line is validated yet — the document and policy-reasoning stack is line-agnostic in design, so we scope additional lines case by case rather than claiming coverage up front.

faq.q: Does it integrate with our TPA workflow?
faq.a: Yes. Newron produces TPA-ready packets and exposes REST + webhook APIs, so it slots into your existing claims platform and TPA handoffs.
The model is trained on historical adjudication outcomes and explains each prediction with the policy clauses and document evidence behind it — never an unexplained score.
All processing runs inside your environment — VPC, on-prem or air-gapped — with full audit logging and data-residency commitments.

cta.title: Run a pilot on *last quarter's claims*.
cta.line: We'll replay a slice of your historical claims through Newron and show you the denial-risk and time-to-file numbers before you commit.
